info.title: VionX API
info.description: Single entry point for the VionX Android app and admin SPA (Supabase Edge Function `api`).

post.description: Returns an opaque session token (30-day sliding expiry). 5 wrong PINs lock the login for 15 minutes; attempts are rate-limited per device and per login id. post.summary: Grant a consent for a child
post.description: Recorded against the current PRIVACY_POLICY version (409 if `policyVersion` is not current). Idempotent for the same version; a grant on a newer version supersedes the old record. AI, microphone and health grants for a child aged 7+ wait for the child’s assent. CROSS_BORDER_TRANSFER is its own explicit grant (never implied by accepting the policy); AI_PERSONALIZATION needs it in force first (403 CONSENT_REQUIRED, `details.consentType` CROSS_BORDER_TRANSFER). Audited; emits `consent.granted`.

post.description: The child login is turned off and every session revoked at once; the profile is hard-deleted after the 14-day grace period, during which the parent can cancel (ledgers anonymised). Idempotent. Audited.

404.description: Not found, or not in your household (NOT_FOUND)

post.summary: Delete the parent account and household data
post.description: Owner: the household is hidden, every child login turned off and the parent signed out everywhere at once; until the purge the parent can still sign in, but every route except this one, its cancel, `GET /v1/me`, `GET /v1/policies/current` and `GET /v1/privacy/overview` answers 403 ACCOUNT_DISABLED (`details.reason` DELETION_PENDING). Everything is hard-deleted after the 14-day grace period (ledgers anonymised). Reachable in the app and from the public web page. Idempotent. Audited.

During the 14-day grace period: the job becomes CANCELLED (the purge skips it) and the child can sign in again (unless the parent had disabled the child before the request; sessions revoked by the request stay revoked). 404 when there is no pending deletion (including after the purge) or for another household’s child; 409 once the purge is due. Audited; emits `privacy.deletion_cancelled`.

post.description: During the 14-day grace period: the job becomes CANCELLED (the purge skips it), the account works again, the household is visible again and its children can sign in (except those disabled before the request or with their own pending deletion). 404 when there is no pending account deletion; 409 once the purge is due. Audited; emits `privacy.deletion_cancelled`.

patch.summary: Edit or archive a task (parent only)
patch.description: Children can never edit tasks (403). When the schedule changes or the task is archived, open days from today on are removed and the new schedule is materialised; days with a completion stay. Audited.

post.summary: The child completes a task day
post.description: Child actor, own tasks only. Idempotent by `clientUuid`: a retry returns the stored result with `replayed: true` and emits nothing (409 if the UUID was used for another task). SELF_CHECK is done at once (also emits `task.approved`); PHOTO_PROOF (needs `proofPath`) and PARENT_APPROVAL wait for the parent (push request to the parents); SYSTEM_VERIFIED cannot be completed by hand (409). Only days up to today. Emits `task.completed` (TaskCompleted).

post.description: Parent only. The day’s pending completion becomes APPROVED; 409 when nothing is pending (e.g. already decided). Emits `task.approved` (TaskApproved) once per completion. Audited.
